description.zh: 原始图片URL地址，必须是公网可以正常访问的地址，最长8K。
description.en: The URL of the original image. The URL must be publicly accessible and can be up to 8 KB in length.

descriptions.zh:
输入单张成图，预测成图的风格类型。


如下图的风格类型：
视觉风格：中国风     语义风格：典雅...

![](http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recoginzer-image-type-src.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_500)
descriptions.en:
Analyzes a single image and predicts its style type.


For example, the style types of the following image:
Visual style: Chinese style     Semantic style: Elegant...

![](http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recoginzer-image-type-src.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_500).
